授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
This course is a completed through a combination of debate practice (generally done through the Kyushu University English Speaking Society), attendance at two or more debate tournaments, and completion of four class sessions on the academic study of debate (classes to be held in both Spring and Fall semesters, schedule to be determined) along with related homework.
This course welcomes students both with and without debate experience.. However, because all debate is done in English, students must have intermediate or higher-level English skills prior to joining the course. All students who are interested in the course must join the associated Moodle course by June 20, 2026.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
様々なタイプのディベートの仕方を理解する
メリット、デメリットの立論作成方法を理解する
反論の基本的な作成方法を理解する
実践の判定について基礎的な指導ができるようになる
ディベートの歴史、社会における位置づけ、そしてディベートにおける倫理的問題について学びましょう。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Understand how to engage in various types of debate.
Understand how to prepare arguments.
Understand how to prepare basic counterarguments.
Learn basic judging practices.
Learn about the history of debate, its position in society, and ethical issues in debate.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
基礎演習などでアクティブラーニングを実施する事になった方

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: Three written reports related to debate experiences and topics taught in Dr. Hahn's class. Two short reports will be 5% of total grade each each, one long report will be 10%.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度:
There are three separate participation requirements for this class. The first two are normally fulfilled through participation in QUDS-related activities (weekly practice and related tournaments). Other tournaments may be allowed if prior approval is sought from the professor.
(1) Participate in 45 hours of  formal debate practice activity. 40% of total course grade
(2) Participate in two or more debate tournaments (total of at least 15 hours). 20% of total course grade
(1) & (2) will be assessed on completion only--students who complete all required hours will receive full points. Students will lose 5% for every two hours they are short of the goals.
In addition, students must attend and actively participate in four classes taught by Dr. Hahn on debate ethics, the history of debate, and related topics. This participation will be assessed based on students' activeness in class, participation in discussions, and evidence that required homework has been completed. 20% of total course grade
